evidence.quote: Click 'Add API key' and select the permissions you need.
Go to Settings → Machine Users and click + Add Machine User
30 tools across threads, customers, tenants, help center articles, and workspace data
You can now connect AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor directly to your Plain workspace using the Plain MCP server.
You authenticate with your existing Plain account, so the MCP server has the same permissions as your user.
Each API key carries its own fine-grained permissions

result.notes: Plain's public API is GraphQL-only (core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1). Credentials are created self-serve via Settings → Machine Users → API Keys, scoped with fine-grained permissions, no admin/partner approval documented. Product access is a 7-day free trial (no credit card) then paid seats starting at $35/seat/month; API/webhooks/events are listed under 'Extensibility' without an explicit paid-tier gate, but sustained use requires converting to a paid plan after trial. Plain also ships an official, vendor-maintained MCP server (mcp.plain.com) authenticated via the user's own Plain account session rather than API keys, exposing ~30 tools over threads/customers/tenants/help-center/workspace data.
result.one_liner: Plain is a B2B customer support / helpdesk platform (threads, customers, tenants, help center) with a GraphQL API and an official MCP server.
